info.title: MARP API
info.description: Generated OpenAPI specification for MARP API V1 routes.

tags.name: Documentation
tags.description: Retrieve the generated OpenAPI specification (as JSON) or open the internal developer (JSDoc) documentation site.

tags.name: V1 · Users
tags.description: Create, update, and look up user accounts by id or name.

tags.name: V1 · Projects
tags.description: Create, update, and look up MARP projects by id or name, including projects a given user belongs to.

tags.name: V1 · Sessions
tags.description: Create, update, and look up dive/survey sessions, including sessions scoped to a user within a project.

tags.name: V1 · Species
tags.description: Create, update, and look up species records and their model_species linkage records used for ML model training/evaluation.

tags.name: V1 · Tasks
tags.description: Create, update, look up, and delete tasks.

tags.name: V1 · Keyframes
tags.description: Bulk-create, look up, update, and delete keyframe records associated with observations.

tags.name: V1 · Observations
tags.description: Access biological observation records and related data. These endpoints support observation retrieval, filtering, aggregation, review workflows, video-based queries, keyframe associations, and observation updates.

tags.name: V1 · Videos
tags.description: Observation queries scoped to a specific video_source, including cross-project video summaries and per-video observation listings.

tags.name: V1 · MachineLearning
tags.description: ML pipeline resources: datasets, dataset-observation links, ML models, training runs, epochs, and metrics (summary and curve) records.

tags.name: V1 · Schema
tags.description: Database schema introspection endpoints for tables, views, columns, constraints, indexes, and relationships in the public schema.

tags.name: V2 · Jellyfin
tags.description: V2 endpoints proxying the Jellyfin media server: library/folder browsing, search-by-name, and playback resolution. Jellyfin itself is never exposed to API consumers -- MARP holds the Jellyfin credentials and session, and the stream endpoint returns a short-lived redirect rather than requiring callers to know Jellyfin exists.

tags.name: V2 · Auth
tags.description: V2 authentication endpoints for MARP-owned local sign-in, session lifecycle management, and authenticated-user session context.

tags.name: V2 · Users
tags.description: V2 user-management endpoints: create/update/soft-delete users, view the permission catalog, and grant/revoke or change a user's local password. Every endpoint requires the `admin` permission.

tags.name: V2 · Tokens
tags.description: V2 service-application endpoints: register applications, issue/revoke/regenerate their bearer tokens, and grant/revoke token permissions from the same catalog used for users. A bearer token satisfies the `admin` permission the same way an admin user session does. Every endpoint requires the `admin` permission.

VideoSummaryReport.description: One aggregated row per distinct video_source/videoLocation combination within a project, produced by observationRepository.getVideoSummariesByProject and served by GET /getVideoSummaries/{project_id}.

video_source.description: Video source shared by every observation in this group. Nullable because observations.video_source itself allows null.

videoLocation.description: Video location shared by every observation in this group. Nullable because observations.videoLocation itself allows null.

distinct_species_count.description: Count of distinct non-null observation comname values in the group. Returned as a numeric string, not a number, because it is a raw Postgres COUNT(DISTINCT ...) aggregate served through Sequelize with raw:true.

session_count.description: Count of distinct sessions contributing observations to the group. Returned as a numeric string for the same raw-aggregate reason as distinct_species_count.

dive.description: Lowest sessions.dive value (database MIN, so string ordering rather than numeric) among the sessions joined into this group. The session join is required and sessions.dive is a required column, so this value is always present.

line.description: Lowest sessions.line value, aggregated independently from dive. Always present for the same reasons as dive.

session_type.description: Lowest sessions.type value (database MIN, string ordering). Always present for the same reasons as dive.

DashboardUserDateEntry.description: Per-day activity counts for one user, nested inside UserDashboardData. KNOWN LIMITATION: sessions and projects are always 0 in the current implementation -- observationRepository.getUserDashboardData only ever populates the observations count.

sessions.description: Always 0 in the current implementation; session counting was never wired up.

observations.description: Number of observations the user created on this date, from a COUNT grouped by session.user_id and DATE(observations.createdAt).

projects.description: Always 0 in the current implementation; project counting was never wired up.

UserDashboardData.description: Dashboard activity data keyed by user display name, then by ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Returned by GET /dashboardData. Both start and end query parameters are required for any rows to be returned -- omitting either produces {} because the underlying Sequelize Op.between filter cannot match against an undefined bound.

additionalProperties.description: Map of ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) to that date's activity entry for this user.

ProjectTimeByDateAndUser.description: Estimated recording minutes keyed by project name, then by ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD), then by user display name. Returned by GET /getProjectTimeByDateAndUser. Both start and end query parameters are required for any rows to be returned, for the same Op.between reason as UserDashboardData. KNOWN BUG: the last observation of every session/day contributes zero minutes to the total, so returned time is systematically undercounted.

additionalProperties.description: Map of ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) to that date's per-user minute totals.
Map of user display name to estimated minutes recorded on this date for this project.

JellyfinItem.description: A Jellyfin library, folder, or video item, normalized down to the fields MARP exposes. DRAFT schema: field examples are real (captured against the live Jellyfin dev server), but this has not yet gone through the full sample-capture-and-infer workflow (docs/openapi-response-schema-workflow.md) used for other custom-shape endpoints.

id.description: Stable Jellyfin item identifier.

path.description: Raw server-side filesystem path Jellyfin stores this item at. Exposed deliberately -- useful for confirming a /resolve fuzzy-match result or feeding tooling that needs the original file location -- at the cost of revealing Jellyfin server storage layout to API consumers.

type.description: Jellyfin item type, e.g. CollectionFolder (a top-level library), Folder, or Video.

isFolder.description: Whether this item is a folder-like container browsable via GET /api/v2/jellyfin/items/{id}/children.

mediaType.description: Jellyfin media type classification (often "Unknown" for folders/libraries).

runtimeTicks.description: Runtime in Jellyfin ticks (100-nanosecond units). Null for folders and other non-playable items.

childCount.description: Number of child items. Present only on folder-like items; null for playable video items.

JellyfinItemList.description: A list of Jellyfin items returned by browsing, searching, or listing libraries.

items.description: Matching or child items, in the order Jellyfin returned them.

JellyfinPlaybackOption.description: One playback quality choice, derived from the item's actual source capabilities (bitrate/resolution) -- a transcode tier is only present if it is genuinely below source quality.

mode.description: Mode to pass to GET /items/{id}/stream to select this option.

maxStreamingBitrate.description: Bitrate ceiling for this option, in bits/sec. Null for Auto/Original.

maxWidth.description: Width ceiling for this option. Null for Auto.

maxHeight.description: Height ceiling for this option. Null for Auto.

isAuto.description: True for the Auto placeholder option.

requiresTranscoding.description: True for a Transcode tier option.

JellyfinPlaybackOptionList.description: The quality menu for one Jellyfin item.

options.description: Available playback options, most capable first.

JellyfinResolveResult.description: Best Jellyfin item match found for a saved database video_source value, via multi-term search and filename/timestamp scoring.

score.description: Match confidence, 0-100. Below the requested minScore is rejected with a 404 rather than returned here.

searchTerm.description: The specific search-term variant that produced this match.

JellyfinPlaybackReportRequest.description: Playback state relayed to Jellyfin's session-tracking endpoints. mediaSourceId/playSessionId should be carried forward from the earlier GET /items/{id}/stream or /items/{id}/playback-options response -- MARP does not store playback session state itself.

mediaSourceId.description: MediaSource id from the earlier stream/playback-options response.

playSessionId.description: PlaySessionId from the earlier stream/playback-options response.

positionTicks.description: Current playback position, in Jellyfin ticks (100ns units).

isPaused.description: Whether playback is currently paused. Ignored (always true) for the stopped report.

playMethod.description: Which stream mode is active for this session.

JellyfinTrickplayInfo.description: Parsed scrubbing-preview tile metadata for one item. Each tile image URL already embeds its own short-lived access token, the same signed-URL pattern used for stream/image URLs, and is directly fetchable by a caller.

width.description: Tile-sheet generation width actually used -- either the width requested, or the auto-selected largest available width when none was requested.

availableWidths.description: Every tile-sheet width Jellyfin has actually generated for this item. Pass one of these as the width query parameter on a future request to pick a specific one deliberately.

thumbnailWidth.description: Width of one thumbnail cell, in pixels.

thumbnailHeight.description: Height of one thumbnail cell, in pixels.

columns.description: Thumbnail columns per tile sheet image.

rows.description: Thumbnail rows per tile sheet image.

thumbnailDurationSeconds.description: Seconds of video represented by each thumbnail cell.

tileImageUrls.description: Tile sheet image URLs, in order. Each sheet packs columns*rows thumbnails; mapping a scrub time to a specific tile/row/column is left to the caller, since it is pure arithmetic once this metadata is known.

Artifact.description: A tracked output file (weights, log, plot, export, etc.) produced during a training run, including its path, size, checksum, and optional contextual metadata.

id.description: Unique identifier for this artifact record.

training_run_id.description: Foreign key referencing the training run this artifact belongs to (training_runs.id).

path.description: Filesystem path or URI to the artifact file or directory.

size_mb.description: File size in megabytes, if available (useful for monitoring disk usage).

hash.description: Checksum or hash of the artifact file (e.g., SHA256) to verify integrity and detect duplicates.

metadata.description: Optional JSON blob with contextual information (e.g., epoch number, export format, or framework version).

created_at.description: Timestamp when this artifact record was created (typically when the file was generated).

updated_at.description: Timestamp when this artifact record was last updated.

Hyperparameters.description: Full hyperparameter configuration used for a specific training run, stored as a JSON blob to preserve reproducibility of training conditions across differing pipelines and model types.

id.description: Unique identifier for this hyperparameter configuration.

training_run_id.description: Foreign key referencing the training run this hyperparameter set belongs to (training_runs.id).

params.description: JSON blob containing all hyperparameters used for this training run (e.g., lr0, momentum, epochs, batch, weight decay, augmentation options). Keys vary by training pipeline and are not individually enumerated here.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this hyperparameter record was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when this hyperparameter record was last updated.

MetricsCurve.description: A single confidence-threshold data point (precision, recall, F1, support) belonging to a metrics_summary record, used to plot detailed evaluation curves.

id.description: Unique identifier for this metrics curve data point.

metrics_summary_id.description: Foreign key referencing the metrics summary record (metrics_summary.id) this curve point belongs to.

species_id.description: Foreign key referencing the species this summary applies to. NULL means it represents an aggregate across all species.

species.description: Optional associated species record when this curve point is scoped to one species.

confidence_threshold.description: Confidence threshold (between 0.0 and 1.0) at which these metrics were measured.

precision.description: Model precision value computed at this confidence threshold.

recall.description: Model recall value computed at this confidence threshold.

f1_score.description: Model F1 score computed at this confidence threshold.

support.description: Number of predictions or detections evaluated at this confidence threshold.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this metrics curve record was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when this metrics curve record was last updated.

MetricsSummary.description: Aggregated evaluation metrics for a single dataset split (train/val/test) within a training run, including paths to generated visualization artifacts and optional per-class detail.

id.description: Unique identifier for this metrics summary record.

training_run_id.description: Foreign key referencing the training run this metrics summary belongs to (training_runs.id).

species_id.description: Foreign key referencing the species this summary applies to. NULL means it represents an aggregate across all species.

species.description: Optional associated species record when this summary is scoped to one species.

dataset_split.description: Specifies which dataset split these metrics apply to - "train", "val", or "test".

precision.description: Aggregate precision achieved for this dataset split.

recall.description: Aggregate recall achieved for this dataset split.

map50.description: Mean Average Precision (mAP) at 0.5 IoU threshold for this split.

map5095.description: Mean Average Precision (mAP) averaged over IoU thresholds 0.5-0.95.

fitness.description: Weighted performance score used by YOLO to rank model checkpoints.

f1_score.description: Aggregate F1 score for this dataset split, typically computed from precision and recall.

confusion_matrix_path.description: Filesystem path or URI to the confusion matrix image generated for this dataset split.

result_plot_path.description: Filesystem path or URI to the overall results plot (e.g., PR or F1 curves) for this dataset split.

confusion_matrix_norm_path.description: Path to the normalized confusion matrix plot image generated during evaluation.

box_f1_curve_path.description: Path to the F1 vs confidence curve plot image.

box_p_curve_path.description: Path to the precision vs confidence curve plot image.

box_pr_curve_path.description: Path to the precision-recall (PR) curve plot image.

box_r_curve_path.description: Path to the recall vs confidence curve plot image.

labels_plot_path.description: Path to the label distribution plot image showing class balance in the dataset.

details.description: Optional JSON blob storing additional data arrays (e.g., per-class metrics or PR/F1-confidence points).

timestamp.description: Timestamp when this metrics summary was created or finalized.

post.description: Clears the current server-side authentication session. Logout is idempotent and always returns 204 even when no authenticated session exists.

204.description: Session cleared successfully (or no session was active).

get.summary: Get the currently authenticated session user
get.description: Returns the currently authenticated MARP user associated with the request session. Returns 401 when the request has no valid authenticated session.
Returns every named permission that can be granted to a user. Requires the `admin` permission.

post.description: Creates a new user with a local username/password credential. Requires the `admin` permission.

get.description: Returns every user, each with their currently granted permission keys. Requires the `admin` permission.
Returns one user, with their currently granted permission keys. Requires the `admin` permission.

put.description: Updates a user's name, username, and/or status. Requires the `admin` permission.

delete.description: Sets the user's status to "deleted". The row and every record the user created (sessions, observations, etc.) are preserved -- only login and session resumption are rejected, the same way "disabled" already works. Requires the `admin` permission.

put.description: Replaces the user's entire permission set with exactly the given keys -- any currently-granted permission not in the list is revoked. Requires the `admin` permission.
Sets a new local login password for the user directly, with no old-password check. Requires the `admin` permission.

post.description: Registers a new application that can be issued bearer tokens. Requires the `admin` permission.

get.description: Returns every registered application, each with its token count. Requires the `admin` permission.
Returns one registered application. Requires the `admin` permission.

put.description: Updates an application's name, description, and/or status. Requires the `admin` permission.

delete.description: Permanently deletes an application and every bearer token issued under it (cascading). Unlike a user soft-delete, this is a real, irreversible removal. Requires the `admin` permission.

post.description: Issues a new bearer token for an application. The raw token is returned exactly once, in this response -- it cannot be retrieved again afterward, only regenerated as a new token. Requires the `admin` permission.

get.description: Returns every issued token across every application (never the raw secret), with its owning application, status, and granted permissions. Requires the `admin` permission.

delete.description: Revokes a token immediately. The token record is kept for history, but is rejected by any future authentication attempt. Requires the `admin` permission.

post.description: Revokes the existing token and issues a brand-new one under the same application. The new raw token is returned exactly once, the same as when a token is first issued. Requires the `admin` permission.

put.description: Replaces the token's entire permission set with exactly the given keys -- any currently-granted permission not in the list is revoked. Requires the `admin` permission.
